# Dependencies

This document sources two local files: `../../02-DHS/config_and_libraries.R`, which defines the path helper, and `gsea_engine.R`, the GSEA engine. Everything else it needs is an installed package.

```{r}
# CRAN / Bioconductor packages
library(clusterProfiler)   # setReadable(), gseaplot()
library(enrichplot)        # as.data.frame() for a compareClusterResult
library(AnnotationDbi)     # mapIds()
library(org.Mm.eg.db)      # mouse SYMBOL annotation (must be installed)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotthis)          # GSEAPlot() for the GSEA running-score panel

# GSEA engine: the wrapper functions the calls below use are in gsea_engine.R.
source("gsea_engine.R")

# Path helper: env_path() reads each input path from an environment variable and stops when it is unset.
source("../../02-DHS/config_and_libraries.R")
```

```{r}
# Sort the tileplot rows by NES across clusters: widen to one column per cluster, join the cluster NES columns back, and order by the cluster levels.
helper_order_df_gsea_by_NES = function(df){
  stopifnot(is.factor(df$Cluster))
  tmp_df_group = df %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = "Description",
                names_from = "Cluster",
                values_from = "NES",
                values_fill = 0)
  df %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(tmp_df_group, by = c("Description")) %>% 
    arrange((across(all_of(levels(df$Cluster))))) %>% 
    mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = unique(Description)))
}
```

# Data

The class proportions are computed per DHS from the per-gene feature counts. Each input path is read from an environment variable (`GSEA_DHS_GENE_MAP_FILE`, `GSEA_GENE_COUNT_FILE`, `GSEA_RESULT_FILE`):

- `df_DHS_gene_unique_map_with_exon_info` — data.frame, one row per DHS, carrying the gene annotation columns `ensembl_gene_id` and `entrezgene_id`.
- `df_gene_count_long` — data.frame in long form, one row per DHS × genotype × feature, with columns `DHS`, `geno`, `selected_features` and `n` (read count).
- `tmp_simplified_gsea` — a `compareClusterResult` from an earlier GSEA run, read back for the tile plot; the notebook computes its own four results into `tmp_list` and does not write this file.

```{r}
df_DHS_gene_unique_map_with_exon_info = readRDS(env_path("GSEA_DHS_GENE_MAP_FILE"))


df_gene_count_long = readRDS(env_path("GSEA_GENE_COUNT_FILE"))

df_category_count = df_gene_count_long %>% 
  mutate(feature_id = str_replace(selected_features, "\\+", "p"),
         feature_id = str_replace(feature_id, "\\-", "n")) %>% 
  group_by(DHS, geno, feature_id) %>% 
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(geno == "WT",
         feature_id %in% c("first_exon_pAp",
             "first_exon_pAn",
              "gradual_degradation_pAp",
             "gradual_degradation_pAn",
              "premature_termination_pAp",
              "premature_termination_pAn", 
              "typical_TTS_pAp",
             "typical_TTS_pAn"
                           )) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "DHS",
              names_from = "feature_id",
              values_from = n)

df_gene_total_count = df_gene_count_long %>% 
  mutate(feature_id = str_replace(selected_features, "\\+", "p"),
         feature_id = str_replace(feature_id, "\\-", "n")) %>% 
  group_by(DHS, geno) %>% 
  summarise(total_count = sum(n), .groups = "drop") 

df_count_for_binomial = df_category_count %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(df_gene_total_count %>% 
                     filter(geno == "WT") %>% 
                     transmute(DHS, total_count), by = "DHS")

```

# Analysis

## GSEA of proportion

Each class is ranked by its per-DHS share of the WT reads, joined to the gene annotation (Ensembl gene id and Entrez id), and passed to the GO GSEA (`GO_or_KEGG = "GO_ALL"`, mouse, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, `pcutoff = 0.1`).

```{r}
df_y = df_count_for_binomial %>%
   filter(
     total_count > 0) %>% 
   mutate(first_exon_pAn = first_exon_pAn / total_count,
          gradual_degradation_pAn = gradual_degradation_pAn / total_count,
          premature_termination_pAn = premature_termination_pAn / total_count,
          typical_TTS_pAp = typical_TTS_pAp / total_count)

tmp_list = list()

for(i in c("first_exon_pAn",
            "gradual_degradation_pAn",
            "premature_termination_pAn", 
            "typical_TTS_pAp")){
  
  df_gsea_background = df_y %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(df_DHS_gene_unique_map_with_exon_info,
                   by= "DHS") %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = ensembl_gene_id,
         entrez_id = entrezgene_id)
  
  tmp_list[[i]] = gsea_by_one_coef(df_coef = df_gsea_background, 
                            coef_name = i,
                            gene_id_map = df_gsea_background,
                            pcutoff = 0.1,
                            GO_or_KEGG = "GO_ALL",
                            species = "mouse",
                            pAdjustMethod = "fdr")

  
}
```

```{r}
tmp_list$gradual_degradation_pAn %>% as.data.frame
```

```{r}

tmp_list$gradual_degradation_pAn %>% clusterProfiler::setReadable(., OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
clusterProfiler::gseaplot(tmp_list$gradual_degradation_pAn, geneSetID = 6)

tmp_gsea_to_visualize = tmp_list$gradual_degradation_pAn %>% 
  clusterProfiler::setReadable(OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)

gene_ranks = tmp_gsea_to_visualize@geneList %>% as.numeric()
names(gene_ranks) = names(tmp_gsea_to_visualize@geneList)
gene_ranks = gene_ranks[!is.na(names(gene_ranks))]

entrez_to_symbol <- mapIds(         
      org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = names(gene_ranks),
      column = "SYMBOL",  
      keytype = "ENTREZID", 
      multiVals = "first"    
  ) 
gene_ranks_symbol <- gene_ranks
names(gene_ranks_symbol) <- entrez_to_symbol[names(gene_ranks)]                              
gene_ranks_symbol <- gene_ranks_symbol[!is.na(names(gene_ranks_symbol))]    

gene_sets_symbol <- lapply(tmp_gsea_to_visualize@geneSets, function(genes){
  tmp = entrez_to_symbol[genes]
  tmp[!is.na(names(tmp))]
})

attr(tmp_gsea_to_visualize@result, "gene_ranks") <- gene_ranks_symbol
attr(tmp_gsea_to_visualize@result, "gene_sets") <- gene_sets_symbol 
  
plotthis::GSEAPlot(tmp_gsea_to_visualize@result, 
                    gs = tmp_gsea_to_visualize@result$ID[2],n_coregenes = 20)
```

### Visualization

The tileplot is built from the merged GSEA result that was saved for `gradual_degradation_pAn`; the four clusters are the four ranked classes.

```{r}

tmp_simplified_gsea = readRDS(env_path("GSEA_RESULT_FILE"))


tmp_gsea = tmp_simplified_gsea %>% 
  fortify.compareClusterResult.withfilter(showCategory = 15,
                                          by = "geneRatio",
                                          split = NULL,
                                          includeAll = TRUE)

tmp_gsea %>% 
      mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster,
                          levels = c(
                            "typical_TTS_pAp",
                            "gradual_degradation_pAn",
                            "premature_termination_pAn",
                            "first_exon_pAn"
                                     ))) %>%
      helper_order_df_gsea_by_NES() %>% 
      ggplot(., aes(x = Cluster, y = Description),
             showCategory=showCategory, includeAll = T) +
      geom_point(aes(color=Direction, size = abs(NES),
                     alpha = -log10(p.adjust))) +
      labs(x = "", y = "")+
      scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.5,1))+
      theme_bw()+
      theme(axis.text.x =element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
            theme(legend.position = "none") 

```
